```sql
WITH nm_regions AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE '%New Mexico%'
    AND border_type = 'state'
),
nm_roads AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.geometry
  FROM roads r
  JOIN nm_regions nr ON ST_Intersects(r.geometry::geometry, nr.geometry::geometry)
  WHERE r.highway IS NOT NULL
),
longest_road AS (
  SELECT id, geometry
  FROM nm_roads
  ORDER BY ST_Length(geometry::geometry) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
road_raster_clip AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(
             r.rast,
             (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM longest_road)
           ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM public.dem_us r
  WHERE ST_Intersects(
        r.rast::geometry,
        (SELECT geometry::geometry FROM longest_road)
      )
),
road_slope_raster AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(clipped_rast, 1) AS slope_rast
  FROM road_raster_clip
),
road_slope_stats AS (
  SELECT ST_Stats(slope_rast, 1, TRUE) AS stats
  FROM road_slope_raster
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT id FROM longest_road) AS road_id,
  (SELECT ST_Length(geometry::geometry) FROM longest_road) AS length_meters,
  (SELECT MAX(val) FROM (SELECT unnest(stats).val FROM road_slope_stats) AS slope_values) AS max_slope_degrees;
```
